title: GT1
lines: THIS BALL IS RETIRED AND NOT AVAILABLE FOR SALE.
The MOTIV GT1 is powered by the Gear Drive inner core. It is a strong symmetric core with a low RG for maximum revs and a moderate diff to control track flare and shot burn-out.
The GT1 bowling ball has been equipped with an aggressive new tread - MOTIVator-T Reactive. It has more bite than MOTIVator-X cover so it gives you a much stronger reaction.
BOX FINISH: 5000 Grit Laser Scan Polished
The GT1 Black Pearl cover is tuned in for medium-heavy oil with 1000 sanding pads and Power Gel Polish. This allows it to read the middle of the lane to provide a strong reaction.
The MOTIV GT1 features an industry first - a pearl NeoMark graphic. The Silver Pearl logos stand out against the Black Pearl cover. It s a killer combination.
